div.div: How do I install a .mcworld file on Bedrock or PE?
Simply double-click or tap the downloaded `.mcworld` file on your device. Minecraft will automatically launch and import the world into your saved worlds list.
How do I install Java Edition maps?
Download the Java `.zip` archive, extract the folder, and paste it directly into your `.minecraft/saves/` directory. Restart Minecraft to see it in your Singleplayer menu.
